name: @myne/dialect
//: Shared markdown-dialect PARSER CORE — the frontend counterpart to the shared `core`/`protocol` Rust crates. Consumed as SOURCE (exports map → .ts) by the desktop client (`src/`) and the mobile client (`myne-mobile/src/`), so a Vite build in either compiles it and there is no drift. The export-renderer layer (html/clip/text) stays with the editor package; this package is the platform-agnostic parser only.
